reason: Adds configurable Channel Monitor V2 health thresholds and merges tolerant factory defaults into the singleton configuration row.
risk: Adding a NOT NULL JSONB column with a default can briefly lock the configuration table, and the follow-up UPDATE rewrites its singleton row.
mitigation: The table contains only one configuration row, the DDL is idempotent, and the JSON merge places existing threshold values on the right so operator-provided keys override the factory defaults.
